theme: conditional semantic extension and adversarial review
question: Which proposed new meanings retain useful evidence after literal lexical rivals, position multiplicity, variant and source-image checks?
outcome: Seven leading candidate families cover nine codes; W158 rejoins the qualified carrier complex and W617 remains a lower segmentation lead. The viewer has 713 codes, 56 selected Sanskrit senses and 20 bounded examples. Claude Opus 5.5 subscription review completed and its hand counts were checked. Fixed analytic maxT uses 1,388 active comparisons; W142 medial p is 0.461108. Joined lexical rival ranks and crosswalk sensitivities are published.
challenge: Final-only grouping hid carrier closing blocks; substitution summaries omitted two codes; literal joins missed attested compounds. Site enumeration and normalization required correction. Public class images hide exact font variants. Initial CLI auth failed before later user subscription login.
remedy: Preserve earlier endpoints; add fixed-moment diagnostics, formula/length/substitution/segmentation audit and finite-join rival tests. Verify vivadha, matya and kaṅkata anchors, correct sense fields and disclose protocol deviations. Complete external and separate Codex reviews; build run-v6.
retry_when: Independently joined archaeological contexts, withheld families or fixed image segmentation can distinguish worker, issuer, goods and grammatical hypotheses; dictionary matches alone do not justify a repeat.
